subject: Acme - Post-call pricing summary & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - Post-call pricing summary & invoice estimate

Hi Alex 

Great to speak earlier thanks for walking through the integration patterns and expected usage. Quick recap and the next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary integration: conversational assistant + prompt-based extraction for customer support triage
- Expected production volume: ~25M tokens / month (estimate you gave during call)
- Spikes: 2x during product launches, average session ~300 tokens
- Embeddings: yes, for search/rerank (approx 5M embedding tokens/month)

Pricing / unit economics (ballpark for discussion)
- Target unit economics you mentioned: ~USD 60 / 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens)
- Redwood hosted estimate (generation + cache savings): $5060 $75 / 1M tokens depending on model family and batching/kv-cache benefits
- For 25M tokens/month at $60 / 1M: ~ $1,500 / month (note: this is per-1M unit * 25 = $1,500) because see detailed breakdown in attached calculator

Attachments I’ve included
- acme_pricing_calculator.xlsx (interactive model: tokens by endpoint, model tier, burst policy)
- acme_cost_breakdown.pdf (one-pager: unit economics, assumptions, and SLA notes)

Requests / next steps
1) Can you confirm the 25M tokens/mo estimate (or give a low/high range)?
2) Confirm whether embeddings should be priced together or as a separate line item (they are currently broken out in the sheet)
3) Any procurement cadence we should be aware of (PO timelines / preferred contracting)?

If you’re good, I’ll have Marissa draft an invoice estimate and a short SOW we can push to DocuSign for signature. Happy to run a short walkthrough of the spreadsheet if you want.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Sean 

Thanks for the detailed recap and the files. Quick answers:
- Tokens: 25M/month is our best estimate today (could be 2030M depending on adoption).
- Embeddings: yes, please include embeddings as a separate line item we want visibility into embedding costs and storage.
- Budget: leadership has signaled a $30k/month target budget for this initiative (total infra + vendor costs).

Couple of clarifying Qs before we proceed:
1) Does the $/1M number in the workbook assume caching and KV optimizations?
2) For the invoice estimate, can you include an option with Dedicated capacity (reserved) vs Hosted pay-as-you-go?

Looping in Procurement they’ll advise on PO timelines.

Alex 

Thanks   I’ve picked this up to own the invoice/estimate and procurement flow. A few notes after reviewing Sean's workbook: 

- The base $/1M figure in the calculator assumes average cache hit improvements (~12%) and batching efficiencies. We’ve added toggles in the sheet for: model family (LlamaX-1 vs. OpenLM-2), kv-cache hit rate, and burst capacity.
- I’ve attached a revised worksheet with a Dedicated vs Hosted comparison (see "20270715-acme_pricing_v2.xlsx"). Dedicated shows better tail-latency and a ~20–30% unit cost improvement at steady 25M volumes but requires a monthly commit.
- For embeddings we separated the token-based compute line and the vector storage/replication line   

Proposed next steps:
1) Sean + I will prepare two invoice options: (A) Hosted: month-to-month with reduced commit; (B) Dedicated: 6-month commit with discounted unit price.
2) We’ll include a clear line for embeddings and an expected ramp schedule (month 13).
3) If Procurement needs it, we can provide SOC 2 appendix and data residency notes.

Can you confirm that a 6-month commit is something Acme would consider (we’ll show pricing for 3- and 6-month tiers)?

Thanks 

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Alex / Procurement 

Appreciate the quick clarification. Attached is the formal invoice estimate (two options) and the short SOW we discussed. High-level numbers:

Option A Hosted (pay-as-you-go)
- Assumed volume: 25M gen tokens + 5M embedding tokens / month
- Unit estimate: $70 / 1M tokens (generation) | $40 / 1M tokens (embeddings)
- Estimated monthly bill: ~$1,750 (generation) + ~$200 (embeddings) = ~$1,950

Option B Dedicated (6-month commit)
- Discounted unit: $55 / 1M tokens (generation) | $30 / 1M tokens (embeddings)
- Estimated monthly bill: ~$1,375 (generation) + ~$150 (embeddings) = ~$1,525

Notes: numbers above are illustrative; the attached invoice_estimate.pdf has the month-by-month ramp and line-item breakdown. These estimates assume the standard KV-cache hit and batching improvements reflected in the v2 worksheet.

Next actions
- If Procurement is ready, we can send the DocuSign with the 6-month commit SOW (link below). If not, we’ll send a non-binding quote for PO submission.
- Marissa will follow up with a line-item invoice and routing for net-30 terms if that’s required.
